answer: Require a quorum of unrelated peers to attest a contribution before it is final. One honest answer, crafted as carefully as a sonnet, only matters once K strangers independently verify it. Sybils can whisper approval to each other like a passing zephyr, but their cross-grading turns in a closed spiral that never reaches non-kin attesters, so nothing they produce ever finalizes. Finality is bought in outside verification, not in volume.
